rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"Adds a GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute (with an optional SurrogateType) that the source generator picks up on class declarations. A new GeneratedFormatterCollector checks the user's formatter class and the data type it formats, then builds an ObjectSerializationInfo marked IsUserDeclaredFormatter. The formatter templates then write a 'partial class' body into the user's class, and the result is added to the model that feeds GeneratedMessagePackResolver. Members are chosen in contractless mode (public read-write members keyed by their names as strings) or from the surrogate's [Key]/[IgnoreMember] annotations.
